items.brief: When John Ream got into brewing beer at home nearly two decades ago, starting out was as easy as opening the kit his wife bought for him as a gift.

items.title: Supreme Court backs Pentagon decision to throw out plea deals for 9/11 alleged conspirators
items.brief: The Supreme Court on Monday declined to review former Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin’s decision to cancel plea agreements with Khalid Sheikh Mohammed and two other defendants accused of plotting the 9/11 terror attack.

items.title: US-Ukraine relationship worsens amid Trump and Zelensky’s mutual distrust
items.brief: The relationship between Ukraine and the United States is facing increasing strain over intelligence sharing, sanctions, Ukrainian attacks on Russian energy and the path to peace.

items.title: Australian lawmaker Helen Haines hit by car outside electorate office in ‘deliberate act,’ PM says
items.brief: An Australian lawmaker is in a critical condition after being hit by a car outside her electorate office in what the Prime Minister says was a “deliberate act,” though police are yet to identify a motive.

items.title: Victoria’s Secret reboots its fantasy with a $50M diamond bra
items.brief: On Sunday night, just when you thought the megawatt spectacle that is the Victoria’s Secret runway show couldn’t get any glitzier, out struts Kylie Jenner in a $50 million diamond brasserie.

items.title: Priest killed by falling crucifix during live streamed Mass
items.brief: A priest has been killed by a falling crucifix at a church in Ecuador as he performed a mass that was being live streamed online.
